exercises.question: Determine if the relation R = {(1, 2), (2, 3), (1, 4)} is a function. Explain your answer.
exercises.question_amharic: ግንኙነት R = {(1, 2), (2, 3), (1, 4)} ፈንክሽን መሆን አለመሆኑን ወስኑ። መልስዎን ያብራሩ።
exercises.correct_answer: R is not a function because the domain element 1 is mapped to two different range elements (2 and 4).
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: R ፈንክሽን አይደለም፤ ምክንያቱም የዶሜን አባል 1 ከሁለት የተለያዩ የሬንጅ አባላት (2 እና 4) ጋር ስለተዛመደ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. List domain inputs: {1, 2}.\n2. Observe input 1 maps to 2 and 4.\n3. Since input 1 repeats, it violates the definition of a function.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. List domain inputs: {1, 2}.\n2. Observe input 1 maps to 2 and 4.\n3. Since input 1 repeats, it violates the definition of a function.
